messages:
Leah CS: Heads-up — NovaRetail flagged renewal hesitation after two late-night latency spikes last week. They want an explanation + credits. Can we align on what we share? cc @Omar AE
Marco SRE: We have metrics on the dashboard (https://redwood.app/dashboards/novaretail). Root cause looks like a mis-sized batcher during a canary. Uptime was within SLA, but p95 exceeded threshold for ~45m across two windows.
Leah CS: Customer wants a simple exec summary + proof for procurement. Also they asked whether onboarding window affects credits (they started 22 days ago).
Tess Legal: We avoid admitting fault. Recommend: "We observed transient elevated latency; per SLA we are sharing evidence and will apply any pro-rated credit after validation." Keep numbers but avoid "caused."
Omar AE: If they're still within 30-day warm-up, propose offering a one-time onboarding goodwill credit and dashboard access instead of a formal dispute. Less friction for renewal.
Marco SRE: Actionables: export ledger CSV + trace bundle (I'll push to https://redwood.app/exports/novaretail/2026-03-18), and add a short incident timeline. Also set an alert to page at p95 breach >1% for 15m. infra-bot: autoscaler scaled 2026-03-18T02:12Z due to burst.
Leah CS: OK I'll draft the customer note using Tess's language + a single-sentence credit offer option. Target send today EOD. Marco, attach ledger link. Omar, prep the exec one-liner for procurement.
Marco SRE: Ledger and traces uploaded.
Leah CS: Sent to customer; offered dashboard access and a pro-rated goodwill credit while we finalize the formal onboarding policy. Marking thread resolved; will reopen if they escalate.
